documents.title: AI Elements
documents.description: Patterns for agentic interfaces, built from shadcn/ui components.

documents.title: Chain of Thought
documents.description: Displays a summary that expands into the steps an agent took.

documents.title: Chat
documents.description: The thread. Message Scroller keeps your place while the reply streams.

documents.title: Checkpoint
documents.description: Marks a point in the conversation you can return to.

documents.title: Confirmation
documents.description: Asks for approval before a tool runs.

documents.title: Context
documents.description: How much of the context window the conversation has used.

documents.title: File Tree
documents.description: The files the agent changed, as a folder tree.

documents.title: Inline Citation
documents.description: A source in the sentence that opens on hover.

documents.title: Message
documents.description: One turn. The person's message, and the agent's reply with its actions.

documents.title: Model Selector
documents.description: Two menus. One picks the model the agent runs, the other picks how hard it thinks.

documents.title: Plan
documents.description: Displays the steps the agent plans to take, and how far it has got.

documents.title: Prompt Input
documents.description: A message field with attachments and a send button.

documents.title: Queue
documents.description: Displays the agent's todo list, split into what is left and what is done.

documents.title: Reasoning
documents.description: Displays the agent's thinking as it streams.

documents.title: Sources
documents.description: Displays the links the agent used for a reply.

documents.title: Stack Trace
documents.description: Displays a failed tool call and its stack frames.

documents.title: Subagent
documents.description: Displays a subagent run, with its tool calls and result.

documents.title: Suggestion
documents.description: A short prompt you can send to the agent in one click.

documents.title: Task
documents.description: Displays the steps the agent takes, as it takes them.

documents.title: Terminal
documents.description: Displays a command the agent runs, with its output as it streams.

documents.title: Test Results
documents.description: Displays a test run by the agent, with its suites and failures.

documents.title: Tool
documents.description: Displays a tool call the agent makes, from input to output.

documents.title: Components
documents.description: Here you can find all the components available in the library. We are working on adding more components.

documents.title: Accordion
documents.description: A vertically stacked set of interactive headings that each reveal a section of content.

documents.title: Alert Dialog
documents.description: A modal dialog that interrupts the user with important content and expects a response.

documents.title: Alert
documents.description: Displays a callout for user attention.

documents.title: Aspect Ratio
documents.description: Displays content within a desired ratio.

documents.title: Attachment
documents.description: Displays a file or image attachment with media, metadata, upload state, and actions.

documents.title: Avatar
documents.description: An image element with a fallback for representing the user.

documents.title: Badge
documents.description: Displays a badge or a component that looks like a badge.

documents.title: Breadcrumb
documents.description: Displays the path to the current resource using a hierarchy of links.

documents.title: Bubble
documents.description: Displays conversational content in a message bubble. Supports variants, alignment, grouping, reactions, and collapsible content.

documents.title: Button Group
documents.description: A container that groups related buttons together with consistent styling.

documents.title: Button
documents.description: Displays a button or a component that looks like a button.

documents.title: Calendar
documents.description: A calendar component that allows users to select a date or a range of dates.

documents.title: Card
documents.description: Displays a card with header, content, and footer.

documents.title: Carousel
documents.description: A carousel with motion and swipe built using Embla.

documents.title: Chart
documents.description: Beautiful charts. Built using Recharts. Copy and paste into your apps.

documents.title: Checkbox
documents.description: A control that allows the user to toggle between checked and not checked.

documents.title: Code Block
documents.description: Displays code, terminal output and diffs with an optional header, line numbers and a copy button.

documents.title: Collapsible
documents.description: An interactive component which expands/collapses a panel.

documents.title: Combobox
documents.description: Autocomplete input with a list of suggestions.

documents.title: Command
documents.description: Command menu for search and quick actions.

documents.title: Context Menu
documents.description: Displays a menu of actions triggered by a right click.

documents.title: Data Table
documents.description: Powerful table and datagrids built using TanStack Table.

documents.title: Date Picker
documents.description: A date picker component with range and presets.

documents.title: Dialog
documents.description: A window overlaid on either the primary window or another dialog window, rendering the content underneath inert.

documents.title: Direction
documents.description: A provider component that sets the text direction for your application.

documents.title: Drawer
documents.description: A drawer component for React.

documents.title: Dropdown Menu
documents.description: Displays a menu to the user — such as a set of actions or functions — triggered by a button.

documents.title: Empty
documents.description: Use the Empty component to display an empty state.

documents.title: Field
documents.description: Combine labels, controls, and help text to compose accessible form fields and grouped inputs.

documents.title: Hover Card
documents.description: For sighted users to preview content available behind a link.

documents.title: Input Group
documents.description: Add addons, buttons, and helper content to inputs.

documents.title: Input OTP
documents.description: Accessible one-time password component with copy-paste functionality.

documents.title: Input
documents.description: A text input component for forms and user data entry with built-in styling and accessibility features.

documents.title: Item
documents.description: A versatile component for displaying content with media, title, description, and actions.

documents.title: Kbd
documents.description: Used to display textual user input from keyboard.

documents.title: Label
documents.description: Renders an accessible label associated with controls.

documents.title: Marker
documents.description: Displays an inline status, system note, bordered row, or labeled separator in a conversation.

documents.title: Menubar
documents.description: A visually persistent menu common in desktop applications that provides quick access to a consistent set of commands.

documents.title: Message Scroller
documents.description: A chat scroll container that anchors turns, opens saved transcripts, follows streamed responses, loads history without jumping, and jumps to any message.

documents.title: Message
documents.description: Displays a message in a conversation, with optional avatar, header, footer, and alignment.

documents.title: Native Select
documents.description: A styled native HTML select element with consistent design system integration.

documents.title: Navigation Menu
documents.description: A collection of links for navigating websites.

documents.title: Pagination
documents.description: Pagination with page navigation, next and previous links.

documents.title: Popover
documents.description: Displays rich content in a portal, triggered by a button.

documents.title: Progress
documents.description: Displays an indicator showing the completion progress of a task, typically displayed as a progress bar.

documents.title: Questionnaire
documents.description: A multi-step questionnaire with single-choice, multiple-choice, freeform, and skippable questions.

documents.title: Radio Group
documents.description: A set of checkable buttons—known as radio buttons—where no more than one of the buttons can be checked at a time.

documents.title: Resizable
documents.description: Accessible resizable panel groups and layouts with keyboard support.

documents.title: Scroll Area
documents.description: Augments native scroll functionality for custom, cross-browser styling.

documents.title: Select
documents.description: Displays a list of options for the user to pick from—triggered by a button.

documents.title: Separator
documents.description: Visually or semantically separates content.

documents.title: Sheet
documents.description: Extends the Dialog component to display content that complements the main content of the screen.

documents.title: Sidebar
documents.description: A composable, themeable and customizable sidebar component.

documents.title: Skeleton
documents.description: Use to show a placeholder while content is loading.

documents.title: Slider
documents.description: An input where the user selects a value from within a given range.

documents.title: Spinner
documents.description: An indicator that can be used to show a loading state.

documents.title: Switch
documents.description: A control that allows the user to toggle between checked and not checked.

documents.title: Table
documents.description: A responsive table component.

documents.title: Tabs
documents.description: A set of layered sections of content—known as tab panels—that are displayed one at a time.

documents.title: Textarea
documents.description: Displays a form textarea or a component that looks like a textarea.

documents.title: Toast
documents.description: A succinct message that is displayed temporarily.

documents.title: Toggle Group
documents.description: A set of two-state buttons that can be toggled on or off.

documents.title: Toggle
documents.description: A two-state button that can be either on or off.

documents.title: Tooltip
documents.description: A popup that displays information related to an element when the element receives keyboard focus or the mouse hovers over it.

documents.description: The building block for reasoning, tool calls, sources and more.
